title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1992-12-06
source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=94107 and DAUD: shnid=33956 by hansokolow using ProTools

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix blend captures a beloved performance despite unknown setlist
ai_review.review: Both reviewers give this recording five stars, lauding the superb matrix blend and calling it a must‑listen. While no specific musical details are mentioned, the high praise for the matrix mix suggests an excellent technical capture of a show that fans remember fondly.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently perfect (5‑star) reviews emphasize outstanding matrix recording quality; lack of musical detail limits full show assessment, yielding a strong but not absolute rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the matrix blend as 'great' and 'excellent', indicating a crisp, well‑balanced capture with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on song performance or set structure were provided.
